title: Your Oxen account is now open
subject: Your Oxen account is now open
attachment_message: Your Account Confirmation Letter is attached to this email as a PDF. It confirms your account details — keep it for your records and share it with anyone who needs to pay you.
welcome_message_2: You can now access the platform, set up your team, order your cards, and start moving funds.
welcome_message_3: If you need anything, we're one message away.
